name: Arte y Pasión Cafe
address: 205 Aragon Ave, Coral Gables, FL 33134, United States
own_site_note: arteypasioncafe.com responde 200 y es la marca 'Arte y Pasión Café' (academia de barismo, cafes y tienda online en Bogota, Colombia). Coral Gables Magazine (coralgablesmagazine.com/?p=79292), en un articulo especifico sobre la ubicacion de 205 Aragon Ave, Coral Gables, cita explicitamente arteypasioncafe.com como el website del negocio. No es un subdominio de plataforma de terceros: es dominio propio de la marca. Por esto se descarta sin construir, por regla PIPELINE.md (website propio => has_own_site true, NUNCA afirmar que no tiene website).

reviewSamples.text: This is my second time here and both times I had a great experience. Second time came with my daughter and she was super excited that the barrista made a bear and cat in our coffee and matcha. Everything was delicious, but the pandebono was outstanding. Carlos, our server was great.
